paragraphs.text: My baby sister likes ice cream.
My dog sings and dances too.
My dog takes a bath too.
We have cookies and hot chocolate.
Put a pan on the stove.
Pour the oil in the pan.
I see a balloon in the sky.
I see shells on the beach.
I see snacks at the store.
I see flowers in the garden.
I see windows on the school.
I see a car in the parking lot.
I see a dog on the sidewalk.
I see buttons on the shirt.
Now it’s fall, now it’s fall.
We are going to our new home.
Oh! I am going up, up, up!
Kitty is not under the bed.
Kitty is not under the sofa.
Kitty is not under the table.
Kitty is not under the chair.
Kitty is not under the desk.
Kitty is not under the car.
"Let's draw our faces," Ms. White said.
"I have a round face," Tom said.
"I have a little nose," Bob said.
"I have a big mouth," Jenny said.
Who is playing in the bushes?
Who is hiding in the tree?
Who is sleeping in the rocks?
Who is swimming in the river?
This one has a small head.
This one has a big mouth.
This one has a long tail.
This one has a long neck.
But it has huge teeth! Ah!
There is so much to look at!
A penny! A nickel! A dime! A quarter! A dollar!
The apple is on the table.
The flower is in the pot.
The egg is in the box.
The cow is on the hill.
The apple is on the box on the cow . . .
. . . on the table on the hill! Whoa!
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven.
One, two, three, four, five, six.
A piece of pie. Yum, yum, yum!
Pull the sled up, up, up.
Pick up a leaf! Pick up a leaf!
The horse goes to the barn.
The farmer goes to the house.
The ants go to the anthill.
I want to play the violin.
I want to play the guitar.
I want to play the harp.
I want to play the flute.
I want to play the xylophone.
I want to play the piano.
I want to play the drums.
We want to play music together!
I put on the candy canes.
Santa puts the presents under the tree.
